input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file listing the genomes to annotate.
input.help_text: One row per genome, with a `sample` column and a `fastx` column pointing at its FASTA. See `assets/schema_input.json` for the full column spec.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

singularity_cachedir.description: Directory to cache Singularity/Apptainer images in.

modules_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to the nf-core modules test data.

metabolic_modelling_options.title: Metabolic modelling options
metabolic_modelling_options.description: Options for optional genome-scale metabolic model reconstruction.

run_gapseq.description: Run GapSeq DOALL to reconstruct a genome-scale metabolic model from the genome FASTA.

gapseq_medium.description: Path to a medium CSV file for GapSeq. Leave unset to let GapSeq auto-predict the growth medium.

run_carveme.description: Run CarVeME to reconstruct a genome-scale metabolic model from the Pyrodigal protein FASTA.

carveme_mediadb.description: Path to a custom CarVeME media database TSV. Leave unset to use the database bundled in the container.

annotation_options.title: Annotation options
annotation_options.description: Toggle individual annotation steps on or off.

run_pyrodigal.description: Run Pyrodigal gene prediction. Set to false to skip gene calling and all CDS annotation.

run_pfam.description: Run Pfam domain annotation with HMMER hmmsearch.

prodigal_meta.description: Force Pyrodigal's `meta` mode for every genome.
prodigal_meta.help_text: By default only genomes under 100 kb use `meta` mode; larger ones use `single`.

pfam_chunksize.description: Protein FASTA chunk size in bytes for the Pfam search.

kofam_chunksize.description: Protein FASTA chunk size in bytes for the KOfam search.

dbcan_chunksize.description: Protein FASTA chunk size in bytes for the dbCAN search.
